name: Turkey Meatball Marinara Mozzarella Skillet
method: skillet (stovetop; meatballs pan-fried in batches, then simmered in marinara and topped with mozzarella in the same pan)
src_nutrition_note: Published per-serving nutrition (533 cal / 34.8g protein / 5.2g total carbs / 4.3g net / 41.2g fat) is for the source's default 2 lb ground beef+sausage. Ground turkey is explicitly named as an option in the source FAQ ('runs leaner, mix with Italian sausage or add an extra egg yolk'). Rebuilt on 93/7 ground turkey the calories drop but the parmesan/mozzarella/oil keep it fat-dense, landing squarely mid-band; total carbs are unaffected and remain ~5g. Clears the 400-650 cal / <=35g carb band on the source's own numbers.
ingredients_verbatim: 2 pounds ground beef, ground sausage or ground elk
3 tablespoons avocado oil or olive oil
unmapped: pork panko (no board home; low-carb breadcrumb substitute - flag for pricer lane; seasoned breadcrumbs also have no board id)
rebuild_note: Lane is ground turkey: source defaults to ground beef/sausage but names turkey as an option. Rebuild the 2 lb meat as 93/7 ground turkey (optionally +1 egg yolk for bind per source). All other ingredients unchanged.
why: A genuinely stovetop, one-skillet turkey meatball dinner (no bake, no pasta, no rice) that clears the low-carb band on published numbers: 533 cal / 5.2g carbs at 8 servings, mid-band and comfortably under the 35g carb ceiling. Tomato-marinara + mozzarella profile is distinct from the run's already-accepted CREAM-sauce turkey meatball skillet and from the catalog's pasta-based turkey-meatball-marinara-pasta. Batch-scales cleanly to 14 (bulk meatballs, simmer, divide). Signature swap ingredient pork panko is deliberately left flagged for the pricer lane rather than dropped.
confidence: high on band/skillet/verification (nutrition read from page, entirely stovetop); medium on protein-purity (source is beef-default with turkey as a stated option, so turkey rebuild is required).
